title: Unit Review: Opinion and Editorial Stance
goal: Review stance adverbs, correcting a misreading, judging with the subjunctive, conceding an objection and the rhetoric of an editorial.
grammar: Unit Review: Opinion and Editorial Stance

items: I can take a clear position in an editorial voice and correct a misreading of it.
I can judge a fact with the subjunctive and grant an objection without giving up my position.
I can open with a question, close with a call and use the words of public debate.
